prose.attack_best: procurement: mutated cycle every 5 tokens (effective 175 vs V 115)

code.attack_best: code_task: mutated cycle every 5 tokens (effective 345 vs V 285)

prose.reason: Keep the shipped zlib plus 4-gram screen for prose deliveries. the current builder padding pools are too repetitive for the effective measure: worst honest delivery reaches only 0.608xV (amazon_listing (effective 304 vs V 500)), below the 1.10xV honest margin. A builder pool fix is out of scope for this item; the hypothetical wide-pool variant reaches 0.998xV, which shows the pool is the cause. the parameterized attack family defeats the effective-words statistic: the strongest attack reaches 1.5217xV (procurement: mutated cycle every 5 tokens (effective 175 vs V 115)), above the 0.85xV attack margin. Surface statistics cannot price mutated and shuffled filler at zero; that is a documented limit of the statistic, not a tuning problem.
prose.longest_repeat_gate: LOG ONLY: longest-repeat share separation is under 3x, so the 0.15 ceiling stays a logged diagnostic, not a gate.
